description: This script manages Vitest profiling workflows, parsing command-line arguments, resolving output directories, building commands for profiling, and executing them. It integrates with Node.js child process modules and file system modules to automate profiling tasks for a testing framework.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to determine operational mode and output directory, with validation.

methods.name: resolveVitestProfileDir
methods.description: Determines the directory for profiling output, defaulting to a temp directory if none specified.

methods.name: buildVitestProfileCommand
methods.description: Constructs the command and arguments to run Vitest under profiling based on mode.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that sets up profiling directory, builds command, and executes profiling process.
